title: Mexican Pinto Bean Tacos
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Mexican dish using pinto beans, perfect for a quick dinner or meal prep.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cumin and chili powder, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pinto beans, and stir to combine.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the bean mixture onto a tortilla and serving.
Serve immediately, garnished with your favorite toppings.
